summary: Abort running optimization experiment and rehydrate previous per-tenant inference profile (batching/caching/quant)
description: Issue summary: MediCore reported sustained p95 latency increases and 503 spikes for tenant medi_mdt_42 after we enabled a staged optimizer experiment that adjusted batching window, KV prefix caching policy and swapped to a q4_0 quant profile in the dedicated pool. They asked us to immediately stop the experiment and restore their previous per-tenant profile because production traffic is impacted.
impact: Approximately 30-40% p95 latency increase for trafficked endpoints used by MediCore (internal ML feature). Elevated 5xx responses causing failed user requests and pager alerts from the customer's SRE. Dedicated capacity is affected for the tenant; other tenants unaffected so far.
environment_summary: Dedicated cluster: cluster-dc-us-east-3. Feature flag used: optimizer-experiment-v2 (targeted to tenant medi_mdt_42). Autoscaling group: dedicated-gpu-ml-3. Model variants: redwood-3b-v1 (fallback available) and gptj-6b-quant (rolled for experiment).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Target tenant medi_mdt_42 and enable optimizer-experiment-v2 with tenant override;
2) Apply profile: dynamic-batching window=75ms, session-coalesce=true, prefix-cache TTL=300s, quant-profile=q4_0;
3) Hit chat endpoint /v1/chat/completions with 1k concurrent short sessions (simulated);
4) Observe tail latency and 5xx rate increase in grafana dashboard.
Note: reproducer uses internal traffic generator used by customer in staging to mimic production traffic shape.
customer_message: We started seeing the degraded latency after the morning window. Our product is seeing timeouts in user flows. Please stop the experiment for medi_mdt_42 and restore the previous profile immediately. We need confirmation once traffic returns to baseline.
comments: Marisol Vega (Support): Received initial report from MediCore and escalated to SRE. Requested ETA for rollback and snapshot ID.

Ethan Brooks (SRE): Investigating. Observing KV cache eviction spikes and a mismatch between long-session tokenization patterns and the q4_0 quant path. Preparing a controlled abort plan (staged traffic switch).
Priya Ramesh (Customer): Confirmed they did not change client behavior. Provided request IDs and times. Asked for temporary traffic pin to fallback model if roll back fails.

Ethan Brooks: Asked for confirmation to execute restore of snapshot snap-2026-03-07-medi_mdt_42 and to disable optimizer-experiment-v2 for that tenant. Scheduled 3-minute quiet window to perform steps.
Marisol Vega: Notified MediCore of planned window 2026-03-10T15:30Z and requested they pause large batch jobs during the operation.
investigation_notes: Telemetry: p95 latency increased from 220ms -> 360ms after experiment rollout (50% increase). 5xx rate for tenant rose from 0.2% -> 1.6%.
KV cache metrics: eviction rate increased 8x; prefix-cache hit ratio fell from 78% -> 32% for long sessions.
GPU utilization: per-worker GPU memory pressure increased due to q4_0 quant path in combination with continuous batching for long sessions causing KV cache churn.

Hypothesis: The q4_0 profile reduces per-token compute but produces larger memory churn when combined with session coalescing and the tenant's typical long-context usage, leading to cache thrashing and tail latency.

Mitigations considered: 1) disable quant profile for tenant (pin to previous quant), 2) reduce batching window to 25ms for tenant, 3) restore snapshot of tenant's previous optimizer profile and traffic pin to fallback model variant while we investigate further.
Snapshot available: snap-2026-03-07-medi_mdt_42 validated on staging with matching traffic shape.
proposed_action_plan: 1) Disable optimizer-experiment-v2 for medi_mdt_42 via feature-flag toggle (console + API);
2) Restore tenant profile from snap-2026-03-07-medi_mdt_42 (restore includes batching window, prefix-cache config, quant profile);
3) Pin traffic for medi_mdt_42 to redwood-3b-v1 (non-quant variant) and set routing weight 100% for 10 minutes to observe stability;
4) Monitor p95/p99, 5xx, and KV eviction metrics for 15 minutes; if stable, gradually reintroduce traffic;
5) Open follow-up internal ticket to run synthetic long-session load tests in staging to reproduce and tune behavior (risk mitigation).
actions_taken: 2026-03-10T15:30Z - Disabled optimizer-experiment-v2 for medi_mdt_42 via console toggle (Ethan B).
2026-03-10T15:33Z - Restored profile from snap-2026-03-07-medi_mdt_42 using tenant-restore tool (Ethan B).
2026-03-10T15:35Z - Pinned routing to redwood-3b-v1 for tenant (100% traffic) and set temporary throttles on session-coalesce (console change).
2026-03-10T15:50Z - Observed p95 drop back to 230ms and 5xx rate fall to 0.3%. KV eviction rate reduced to baseline over next 10 minutes.
resolution: Immediate resolution: Restored previous optimizer profile snapshot and disabled the experiment for the tenant. Traffic pinned to non-quant model for stability.

Short-term follow-up: Run targeted staging tests for the tenant's request shapes and attempt a phased experiment re-run with conservative batching window and disabled session-coalesce for long sessions.

Long-term: Update experiment preflight checklist to include a 'long-session' sample test for quant profile combinations and add an automatic circuit-breaker to pause quant path if KV eviction ratio exceeds 4x baseline.
Customer confirmation: Priya Ramesh (MediCore) confirmed user flows recovered at 15:55Z and thanked the team for the quick restore.
postmortem_followup_items: Create INT ticket to add automated guardrail for q4_0 quant when prefix-cache hit ratio < 50% (owner: Serving Runtime).
Add a preflight synthetic test case for long sessions to the optimizer experiment checklist (owner: Research/Applied ML).
Schedule post-incident review with MediCore and internal SRE to share findings and agree on safe ramp parameters (owner: Customer Success).
final_status_note: Tenant profile restored and experiment disabled. Monitoring will continue for 24 hours; follow-up items assigned.
